(function(){
  try{
    var d=document.documentElement;
    var sink=localStorage.getItem('luliy-sink')||'default';
    var map={'default':'default','sakura':'sakura','your-name':'your-name','space':'space','sunset':'sunset','mono':'mono'};
    var theme=map[sink]||'default';
    var bg=localStorage.getItem('luliy-bg');
    var blur=parseInt(localStorage.getItem('luliy-bgblur')||'0',10)||0;
    var pw=parseInt(localStorage.getItem('luliy-pbwidth')||'0',10)||0;
    var sans=localStorage.getItem('luliy-sans')||'0';
    var defBg='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/luliy6/luliy6.github.io/refs/heads/main/static/img/bg.png';
    var url=bg||defBg;
    /* inline critical vars + theme attr BEFORE first paint to kill FOUC */
    d.style.setProperty('--luliy-bg-url','url(\''+url+'\')');
    d.style.setProperty('--luliy-bg-blur',blur+'px');
    d.style.setProperty('--luliy-pb-extra',pw+'px');
    var css='html,body{background-image:url(\''+url+'\')!important;background-size:cover!important;background-position:center!important;background-attachment:fixed!important;}';
    var st=document.createElement('style');st.id='luliy-fouc';st.textContent=css;
    (d.head||d).appendChild(st);
    /* set theme + font class on <html> now; JS will mirror to body */
    d.setAttribute('data-luliy-theme',theme);
    if(blur>0)d.setAttribute('data-luliy-bgblur','1');
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){
      if(document.body){
        document.body.setAttribute('data-luliy-theme',theme);
        if(blur>0)document.body.classList.add('luliy-bg-blurred');
        if(sans==='1')document.body.classList.add('luliy-sans');
        if(sans==='2')document.body.classList.add('luliy-canger');
      }
    });
  }catch(e){}
})();
</script>
